thread:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: high 5xx rate observed for ingress-alb-prod in euc1 (zone b). Traffic spike + connection resets from Envoy. Root TS: 1775003141

Sam: I'm on it. seeing ~18% 5xx from frontend service behind ingress-alb-prod. Envoy logs show lots of "connection reset by peer" to upstream pods.

Miguel: Can you paste the ALB target health and envoy restart counts? Could be AZ network flapping or pod restarts.

Sam: pulling quick metrics
```
ALB (ingress-alb-prod) 5xx rate: 18.3% over 2m
TargetGroup: frontend-tg-euc1 - Unhealthy: 2/8 (az-b)
Envoy restarts (last 10m): 0
Envoy upstream resets: 4.5k/min
```

Priya: @Sam can you check NLB layer? We had a partial route53 failover test earlier, maybe DNS cached routes still pointing to euc1-only targets.

Sam: checking k8s endpoints and service topology
```
kubectl get endpoints frontend -n prod -o wide
# endpoints show 6/8 in az-b not ready
kubectl describe ingress frontend-ingress -n prod
# no recent config changes
```

Dana: I'm seeing intermittent AZ isolation events in provider console for euc1-b. Some VPC ENIs transiently lost. Vendor status shows degraded networking in that AZ.

Priya: OK that's consistent. ALB is still in the region but some targets in az-b are flapping. ALB cross-zone load balancing should be enabled, but if route table / ENIs drop traffic we get resets.

Sam: Mitigation plan proposal:
- cordon/drain unhealthy nodes in az-b (reduce resets)
- increase ingress replicas in healthy AZs
- add temporary route53 weighted failover to favor euc2 for critical paths
- update status page & notify support

Miguel: We'll need quick customer impact assessment. Which customers are affected (tenant list) and are writes being dropped? Any data loss? @support-bot can you give affected account list from recent 5xx traces?

support-bot: Querying traces for 5xx tags -> found 12 distinct customer tokens with errors in last 10m. Top impacted: corp-acme, finance-zen, app-alpha. No write-confirmation failures detected in logs; most are request timeouts and connection resets.

Sam: I'm going to route new traffic away from az-b by setting ALB target group deregistration for targets in az-b and scale up targets in az-a and az-c.

Priya: Hold on before deregistering. If we deregister, connections in flight might reset. Instead: set target group slow start to 10s and reduce weight for az-b via NLB? If ALB supports per-AZ weights we can shift gradually.

Sam: Good point. I'll start a graceful drain on nodes in az-b and bump ingress replicas in az-a/c.

Sam: Running:
```
kubectl drain ip-az-b-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n prod
kubectl scale deploy/ingress-nginx -n infra --replicas=8
```

Sam: Node drain accepted; pods are rescheduling to az-a/c. Envoy reset rate dropping to 6k/min -> 2k/min in 2m window.

Dana: Cloud provider confirmed partial network impairment cleared for some ENIs. Still seeing higher latency to az-b metadata endpoints; they're investigating. They suggested leaving az-b drained for 30m.

Miguel: Good. Can we enable cross-region fallback for critical customers? Use traffic-split to euc2 for corp-acme and finance-zen.

Priya: I'm initiating a route53 weighted record change for api.redwood.com to shift 60% to euc2 for the next 20m (manual rollback ready). Executing now.

Priya: route53 change submitted (change id: /Z2EXAMPLE/CHG12345). TTL still 60s, but clients with longer caches will take time.

Sam: 5xx rate overall down to 4.2% now. Target health for az-b continuing to show degraded but number of requests hitting az-b is much lower.

Support (dana-support): Messaging support: we have a partial outage affecting some customers in euc1 - most requests are degraded with 5xx/timeouts. Message queued for engineers to approve before send. Draft:
"We are currently investigating intermittent errors impacting API requests in euc1. We're mitigating by routing traffic to another region; no data loss expected. We'll update in 30 minutes." 

Miguel: Approve. Send now with note: include impacted customer list from support-bot.

Support (dana-support): Sent. Slack escalation to account leads for corp-acme and finance-zen done :email:.

Sam: On-call handoff incoming: Priya will take over incident ops in ~8m. I'll summarize current state before handoff:
- Root cause: partial AZ network impairment in euc1-b causing target flapping and Envoy upstream resets -> 5xx spikes
- Current status: traffic partially shifted to euc2, az-b targets drained, ingress replicas scaled up in az-a/c
- Impact: ~12 customers observed errors, top 3 notified, no confirmed data loss
- Mitigation actions executed: node drain in az-b, scale up ingress, route53 weighted shift, support notification
- Next steps: keep az-b drained for 30m, monitor ALB target health and Envoy resets, cloud provider will post an update in 15m

Priya: Taking over. I'll watch for any reappearance and coordinate with cloud provider. If target health doesn't recover after 30m, we'll move to full region failover for critical tenants.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: oncall change recorded -> Sam -> Priya at 1775003570

Sam: Thanks. I'll do a quick runbook note and upload traces to the incident doc.

Miguel: Before we close, add postmortem items:
- Improve ALB per-AZ weight controls automation for degraded AZs
- Add alerting for envoy upstream reset rates (threshold > 1k/min)
- Route53 lower TTL for api endpoints during planned failover windows
- Run failure drills simulating single AZ network impairment

Priya: Also: consider adding health checks that use a short-lived per-AZ probe to detect partial network degradation earlier.

Sam: Closing active mitigation. Will keep thread pinned for follow-ups. Last observed 5xx: 1.1% at 1775003620

incident-bot: SEV2 -> reduced to SEV3 (monitoring). Please file postmortem and link to thread.
